Below is a concise list of the **long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023** (i.e., holidays that fall on a Friday, Saturday, or Monday, or are observed on a Monday when they fall on a weekend).  
The dates shown are the *actual holiday dates*; the “long‑weekend” span includes the adjacent weekend days.

| Long‑Weekend Span | Holiday (Observed) | Notes |
|-------------------|--------------------|-------|
| **Jan 1 – Jan 3** | New Year’s Day (Observed Jan 2) | New Year’s Day falls on Sunday; observed on Monday. |
| **Feb 18 – Feb 20** | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba, Ontario, BC) | Most provinces observe Family Day on the 3rd Monday of February. |
| **Apr 7 – Apr 9** | Good Friday | Good Friday is a federal holiday; the weekend is Friday‑Sunday. |
| **May 20 – May 22** | Victoria Day | Celebrated on the Monday preceding May 25. |
| **Jul 1 – Jul 3** | Canada Day (Observed Jul 3) | Canada Day falls on Saturday; observed on Monday. |
| **Sep 2 – Sep 4** | Labour Day | Labour Day is always on the first Monday of September. |
| **Oct 7 – Oct 9** | Thanksgiving | Thanksgiving is on the second Monday of October. |
| **Nov 11 – Nov 13** | Remembrance Day (Observed Nov 13) | Remembrance Day falls on Saturday; observed on Monday. |
| **Dec 23 – Dec 25** | Christmas | Christmas is on Monday; the long weekend is Friday‑Monday. |
